name: angular-expert
description: Generates and refactors version-aware Angular and TypeScript code following official documentation, established codebase patterns, and Jest unit tests with an 80% coverage gate.

interface.shortDescription: Implement version-aware Angular code with Jest and an 80% coverage gate
interface.longDescription: Detects the Angular, TypeScript, Node and build tool versions from package.json, angular.json and tsconfig.json before suggesting any dependency or code, follows the codebase architecture and official Angular guides, prefers standalone components, signals, OnPush and zoneless change detection when supported, respects existing RxJS and test conventions, and writes Jest unit tests with jest-preset-angular under an 80% coverage gate.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature following the Angular and TypeScript versions detected in the project
Review my Angular code against the official guides and existing codebase conventions
Write Jest unit tests with jest-preset-angular and at least 80% coverage
